parameters.query: SELECT id, titre, description, competences_requises FROM offre_emploi WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO candidatures (
  message_id,
  email_expediteur,
  sujet_email,
  date_reception,
  nom_fichier_cv,
  texte_cv,
  resume_candidat,
  competences,
  score_compatibilite,
  points_forts,
  points_faibles,
  analyse_complete,
  offre_emploi_id
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10::jsonb, $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb, $13
)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET
  score_compatibilite = EXCLUDED.score_compatibilite,
  resume_candidat = EXCLUDED.resume_candidat,
  competences = EXCLUDED.competences,
  points_forts = EXCLUDED.points_forts,
  points_faibles = EXCLUDED.points_faibles,
  analyse_complete = EXCLUDED.analyse_complete,
  date_traitement = NOW()
RETURNING id, score_compatibilite;
